title: 1990 AHSME Problem 7
statement: A triangle with integral sides has perimeter \(8.\) The area of the triangle is

solutions.text:
The only unordered positive integral side lengths summing to \(8\) and satisfying the triangle inequality are \(2,3,3.\) Their semiperimeter is \(4,\) so Heron’s formula gives \[ \begin{aligned} K&=\sqrt{4(4-2)(4-3)(4-3)}\\ &=2\sqrt2. \end{aligned} \]

Thus the correct answer is A.
